name: Rota
source:
A veteran Valkyrie, trusted by Hildr. Although she is an elf of light, she has became a Valkyrie. She is a practical person who doesn't know unless she tries.

She deeply respects Hildr as a senior Valkyrie and as a commander, She is willing to die if Hildr would command it.

He wants to train Thrud as a new Valkyrie, because she would like to give her a hard time. But since she is the daughter of Thor, the God of thunder, she is conflicted between giving her a hard time and respecting her due to who she is.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150504090832/http://www.matsuri-kikaku.com/matsuri/val2/val2_cha2.html]archived official site[/url]]
